why: ¶62 states that a party of gypsies camped within a mile of the murder scene; ¶37 also mentions the gypsies of Dartmoor.
¶62 describes the gypsies' encampment near the murder site, so 'the gypsy camp' refers to something the story has already stated.
¶62 says the gypsies were gone on Tuesday; Tuesday is also the race day named in ¶14 and ¶18.

text: Where is Silver Blaze? — with the gypsies
why: The question of where the horse is was raised by ¶37, and ¶62 has just put forward the gypsies as a possible explanation, so the story gives a reader reason to consider it.
